faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MNLU Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the MNLU Mumbai Various Contractual Positions is 28th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MNLU Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies for various contractual positions in the Maharashtra National Law University Mumbai (MNLU Mumbai) recruitment drive for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the MNLU Mumbai posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all the posts is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for MNLU Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for the MNLU Mumbai Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the MNLU Mumbai contractual positions will involve Document Verification followed by an Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages to be considered for the role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for MNLU Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application for the MNLU Mumbai Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the highest salary offered in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The highest salary offered in this recruitment is Rs. 80,000/- per month for the post of Programme Coordinator for Legal Aid Programme.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications vary by post, ranging from Higher Secondary (12th) to Master’s degree in Law, MSW, or related fields, with specific experience requirements for some positions.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Maharashtra National Law University Mumbai, which is www.mnlumumbai.edu.in.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any relaxation in the age limit?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation will be provided to candidates belonging to reserved categories as per the rules and regulations set by the government.
